observation.command:
cd /workspace/deployment && timeout 60 docker run --rm --entrypoint sh qgis/qgis-server:3.44.7-noble -c '
set -x
mkdir -p /etc/postgresql-common &&
printf "[qonnectra]\nhost=db\nport=5432\ndbname=qonnectra\nuser=qgis_user\npassword=x\nsslmode=disable\n" > /etc/postgresql-common/pg_service.conf &&
mkdir -p /var/www/data/qgis &&
ln -sf /usr/lib/cgi-bin/qgis_mapserv.fcgi /var/www/data/qgis/qgis_mapserv.fcgi &&
rm -f /tmp/.X99-lock &&
fc-cache &&
/usr/bin/Xvfb :99 -ac -screen 0 1280x1024x16 +extension GLX +render -noreset >/dev/null &
sleep 2 &&
grep -q "client_max_body_size" /etc/nginx/nginx.conf || sed -i "/http {/a\    client_max_body_size 500M;" /etc/nginx/nginx.conf &&
nginx &&
spawn-fcgi -F 2 -u www-data -g www-data -d /var/lib/qgis -P /run/qgis.pid -p 9993 -- /usr/lib/cgi-bin/qgis_mapserv.fcgi &&
echo "ALL GOOD" &&
tail -f /dev/null
' 2>&1 | tail -40
